public.text: Application Service is described parenthetically as “capability,” although Section 3.1 defines capability and application service as distinct element types. This is internally inconsistent.
public.suggestedRevision: Remove “capability” from the parenthetical statement. State that the Application Service is the externally observable unit against which service behaviour can be assessed, while capability remains a higher-level ability.
